lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: seetal har har naam simarat tapat jaai ||3||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanaa naanak jan dhooraa ||
lines.translation: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sagale sidh bhae bhetiaa gur pooraa ||4||10||112||
lines.translation: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||10||112||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d gunee nidhaan guramukh jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kripaal daiaal har ra(n)g maaneeai ||1||
lines.translation: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t milaah har kathaa kahaaneeaa ||
lines.translation: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin simarah naam taj laaj lokaaneeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anad ghanaa ||
lines.translation: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa mohu sa(n)saar jhoothaa vinasanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g nehu kinai viralai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n suhaavaa mukh jin har dhiaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh kaal simarat mit jaavaee ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kai sukh soi jo prabh bhaavaee ||4||11||113||
lines.translation: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu meet ikatr hoi ras kas sabh bhu(n)chah ||
lines.translation: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam har har japah mil paapaa mu(n)chah ||1||
lines.translation: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat veechaarahu sa(n)t janahu taa te bighan na laagai ||
lines.translation: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kheen bhae sabh tasakaraa guramukh jan jaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: budh gareebee kharach laihu haumai bikh jaarahu ||
lines.translation: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa hat pooraa saudaa vakhar naam vaapaarahu ||2||
lines.translation: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan arapiaa seee pativa(n)te ||
lines.translation: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa nit kel kara(n)te ||3||
lines.translation: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat mad jo peevate bikhalee pat kamalee ||
lines.translation: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands of prostitutes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam rasaain jo rate naanak sach amalee ||4||12||114||
lines.translation: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam keeaa karaaiaa aara(n)bh rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam jape jap jeevanaa gur ma(n)tr driRaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paai parah satiguroo kai jin bharam bidaariaa ||
lines.translation: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sach saaj savaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi leene aapane sach hukam rajaaee ||
lines.translation: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh ditee daat saa pooran vadiaaee ||2||
lines.translation: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun gaaeeahi jap naam muraaree ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of the Destroyer of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nem nibaahio satiguroo prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||3||
lines.translation: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhan gun gaau laabh poorai gur ditaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: vanajaare sa(n)t naanakaa prabh saahu amitaa ||4||13||115||
lines.translation: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker. ||4||13||115||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur tuhee prabh taa ke vadabhaagaa ||
lines.translation: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ohu suhelaa sad sukhee sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1||
lines.translation: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham chaakar gobi(n)d ke thaakur meraa bhaaraa ||
lines.translation: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan sagal bidh so satiguroo hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa naahee aur ko taa kaa bhau kareeai ||
lines.translation: There is no other whom I should fear.
